card.name: Last piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a brand-name drug, just before where a trademark mark or ® would follow. Seen in names like Dyazide, Betadine, Maalox and Clarinex.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: Ending piece of an all-caps product name in label headings or text.

modes.label: Mixed-case brand names
modes.description: Ending piece of a brand name given as an example of a drug, often followed by ®.

card.writes: It promotes trademark endings such as TM and Plus, so the model expects a trademark mark after the brand name.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a brand drug name, where a ™ or ® symbol would come next.
